hook.convey: one whole stretch from start = 0 to finish = 1; stopping exactly halfway → standing on a real spot → 0 and 1 have no name for it → fractions are numbers that live between 0 and 1

use.hi: Cricket ki pitch socho. Ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman run lene bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, toh us jagah ka bhi ek number hai.
use.en: Picture a cricket pitch. One stump at 0, the other at 1. The batsman sets off for a run and stops right in the middle. He's standing on a real spot, so that spot has a number too.

use.hi: Ghar 0 par, school 1 km par. School bus aadhe raaste mein ruk gayi. Na 0 par, na 1 par, beech mein kahin. Us jagah ka bhi number hota hai.
use.en: Home is at 0, school at 1 km. The school bus stops halfway. Not at 0, not at 1, somewhere in between. That place has a number too.

use.hi: Game mein level ka bar 0 se bharna shuru hota hai, aur 1 par level khatam. Abhi bar aadha bhara hai. Matlab woh 0 aur 1 ke beech ke ek number par ruka hai.
use.en: In a game the level bar starts filling at 0, and at 1 the level is done. Right now it's half full. So it has stopped at a number between 0 and 1.

explain.convey: 0 and 1 at the ends; one cut exactly in the middle → 2 equal gaps; the middle mark = 1/2 → 1/2 is a number with its own place, between 0 and 1, not at 2

point.hi: Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark lagaya, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2.
point.en: Here's a line from 0 to 1. One mark right in the middle, and now the line has 2 equal gaps. This mark is called 1/2.

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 1/3 toh 3 ke paas aata hai. Tumhe kya lagta hai: 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par hai, ya 3 ke paas?
prompt.en: {friend} says 1/3 goes near 3. What do you think: is 1/3 on this line from 0 to 1, or near 3?

why.hi: 1/3 woh jagah hai jahan 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps mein pehla gap khatam hota hai, isi line par
why.en: 1/3 is where the first of 3 equal gaps from 0 to 1 ends, right on this line

simpler.hi: 1/2 bhi 0 aur 1 ke beech tha, 2 ke paas nahi. 1/3 bhi ek poore ka ek tukda hai.
simpler.en: 1/2 sat between 0 and 1, not near 2. 1/3 is also a piece of one whole.

explain.convey: same 0 to 1, now 3 marks inside → 4 equal gaps (gaps = marks inside + 1); bottom number = number of equal gaps in 0 to 1; first mark from 0 = end of 1 gap = 1/4; the name comes from gaps, not marks

point.hi: Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab upar 3 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 4 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/4.
point.en: Same line from 0 to 1, but now there are 3 marks on top. Don't count the marks, count the gaps: 4 equal gaps. So the first mark after 0 is 1/4.

prompt.hi: Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Neeche line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
prompt.en: Now look under the line. There are 7 marks between 0 and 1, all evenly spaced. How many equal gaps does that make below?

why.hi: beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps
why.en: there's always one more gap than marks in between, so 7 marks make 8 gaps

simpler.hi: Upar 3 marks the aur gaps 4, yaani gaps ek zyada. Neeche ke 7 marks par bhi yahi chalega.
simpler.en: On top there were 3 marks and 4 gaps, one more gap. The same works for the 7 marks below.

explain.convey: each quarter cut in half → 8 equal gaps → each gap smaller; 1/8 = first mark, right next to 0; 1/2 still the middle mark (4 of the 8 gaps); more equal gaps in the same whole → each gap shorter → 1/8 sits closer to 0 than 1/4 and 1/2

point.hi: Ab har gap ko beech se kaat diya. Line ke 8 barabar gaps ho gaye, aur har ek pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8, bilkul 0 se chipka hua. Beech wala mark ab bhi 1/2 hai.
point.en: Now each gap is cut in half. The line has 8 equal gaps, and each one is a smaller gap than before. The first mark is 1/8, right up against 0. The middle mark is still 1/2.

prompt.hi: Socho yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati ho. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/5 ya 1/10?
prompt.en: Imagine the same line cut into 10 equal gaps. Which stops closer to 0: 1/5 or 1/10?

why.hi: 10 gaps wala har gap 5 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas
why.en: a gap out of 10 is smaller than a gap out of 5, so 1/10 stops sooner, nearer 0

simpler.hi: 8 gaps hue toh pehla mark 1/8 ekdum 0 ke paas aa gaya. Gaps jitne zyada, pehla mark 0 ke utna hi paas.
simpler.en: With 8 gaps, the first mark, 1/8, moved right up to 0. The more gaps, the closer the first mark sits to 0.

problem.hi: Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par khade hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai?
problem.en: Home is at 0 and school is at 1 km. Along the road between them stand 3 electric poles, evenly spaced. How many km from home is the first pole?

givens.hi: poora raasta 1 km ka, aur beech mein 3 khambe
givens.en: a 1 km road with 3 poles in between

find.hi: pehle khambe ki doori, km mein
find.en: how far the first pole is, in km

do.hi: Ek line kheencho, ghar 0 par aur school 1 par
do.en: Draw a line with home at 0 and school at 1

why.hi: ghar se school tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai
why.en: the whole road from home to school is our one whole

simpler.hi: Bas do jagah pakki karo: ghar 0 par, school 1 par. Beech ka saara raasta ek poora hai.
simpler.en: Fix just two spots: home at 0, school at 1. All the road in between is one whole.

do.hi: Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino
do.en: Don't count the poles, count the gaps between them

why.hi: beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada
why.en: there is always one more gap than marks in between

simpler.hi: Ghar se pehle khambe tak ek gap, phir khambe se khamba, aur aakhri khambe se school tak ek. 3 khambe, 4 gaps.
simpler.en: Home to the first pole is one gap, then pole to pole, then the last pole to school. 3 poles, 4 gaps.

prompt.hi: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne km par hai?
prompt.en: The road is in 4 equal gaps, and the first pole is just one gap from home. At how many km is it?

simpler.hi: Poora 1 km, 4 barabar tukde. Ek tukda poore ka kaunsa hissa hai, bas yahi socho.
simpler.en: The whole 1 km, in 4 equal pieces. Just think which part of the whole one piece is.

answer.hi: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 km door hai
answer.en: the first pole is 1/4 km from home

why.hi: 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 km ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai
why.en: with 4 equal gaps each gap is 1/4 km, and the first pole stands exactly one gap from 0

prompt.hi: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 2 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: This line has 2 evenly spaced marks between 0 and 1. What fraction is the first mark after 0?

why.hi: 2 marks se line ke 3 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/3
why.en: 2 marks make 3 equal gaps, and the first mark is one gap along, at 1/3

simpler.hi: Marks chhodo, gaps gino. 2 marks se jitne gaps bane, wahi neeche wala number hai.
simpler.en: Forget the marks, count the gaps. However many gaps the 2 marks make, that's the bottom number.

prompt.hi: Ek baar 0 se 1 ko 3 barabar gaps mein kaato, ek baar 10 mein. 0 ke zyada paas kaun hai: 1/3 ya 1/10?
prompt.en: Once, cut 0 to 1 into 3 equal gaps; once, into 10. Which is closer to 0: 1/3 or 1/10?

why.hi: 10 tukdon wala hissa 3 tukdon wale se kaafi chhota hai, toh 1/10 pehle rukta hai, 0 ke paas
why.en: a tenth is much smaller than a third, so 1/10 stops sooner, near 0

simpler.hi: Ek roti 3 logon mein baanto, ya 10 logon mein. Jis baar tukda chhota mile, wahi 0 ke paas rukta hai.
simpler.en: Share one roti among 3 people, or among 10. Whichever way the piece is smaller, that one stops nearer 0.

prompt.hi: Yeh line 0 se 3 tak jaati hai. 1/2 kin do poore numbers ke beech aayega?
prompt.en: This line goes from 0 to 3. Between which two whole numbers does 1/2 go?

why.hi: 1/2 ek poore ka aadha hai, toh woh pehle poore mein, 0 aur 1 ke beech rehta hai
why.en: 1/2 is half of one whole, so it lives in the first whole, between 0 and 1

simpler.hi: 1/2 matlab ek poore ka aadha. Pehla poora 0 se shuru hota hai, aadha wahin kahin milega.
simpler.en: 1/2 means half of one whole. The first whole starts at 0, so the half is somewhere there.

ladder.why: den 2: one cut, gaps obvious → fraction as a place on the road; same den as e1
den 4 (halves halved, as in e2 and the worked example) → 2nd mark = 2/4 → same spot as 1/2; gap-value thinking, not mark counting
den 6 given as gaps → apply bottom = gaps to a new den outside the halving family 2 → 4 → 8
den 5 given only as marks (4 inside) → must convert marks to gaps; error-spot on the count-marks trap
den 6 again but given as 5 inside marks → contrasts with rl-o1 (same den, gaps given) → explain why the label is wrong

remediation.move: ribbon at a tailor's shop, 0 to 1 m; marks = chalk marks (nishaan), gaps = ribbon pieces; marks inside + 1 = pieces; the fraction names a piece of length, so bottom number = pieces the metre is in; 5 marks → 6 pieces → first mark at 1/6 m

say.hi: Darzi ki dukaan ka ribbon socho, 0 se 1 metre. Us par 5 chalk ke nishaan, aur ribbon ke 6 barabar tukde. Pehla nishaan pehle tukde ke end par hai, isliye 1/6 metre par. Fraction tukde ka naam hai, nishaan ka nahi.
say.en: Picture a ribbon at the tailor's, 0 to 1 metre. It has 5 chalk marks, and the ribbon is in 6 equal pieces. The first mark ends the first piece, so it's at 1/6 metre. A fraction names the piece, not the mark.

simpler.hi: 5 nishaan, 6 tukde. Hum tukde ka naam lete hain, toh pehla nishaan 1/6 metre par hai.
simpler.en: 5 marks, 6 pieces. We name the piece, so the first mark is at 1/6 metre.

prompt.hi: Ab 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 10 chalk ke nishaan hain, barabar doori par. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?
prompt.en: Now a 1 metre ribbon has 10 evenly spaced chalk marks in between. At how many metres is the first mark?

why.hi: 10 nishaan se ribbon ke 11 barabar tukde bante hain, aur pehla nishaan pehle tukde ke end par, 1/11 metre par
why.en: 10 marks cut the ribbon into 11 equal pieces, and the first mark ends the first piece, at 1/11 metre

simpler.hi: Nishaan nahi, tukde gino. Tukde hamesha nishaanon se ek zyada hote hain.
simpler.en: Count the pieces, not the marks. There's always one more piece than marks.

remediation.move: one 0-to-1 line split into 6, then 12 equal pieces; the first piece from 0 each time: 1/6 stops further along, 1/12 halfway to it → 12 is the bigger number but its piece is smaller → more equal pieces in the same whole → each piece shorter → it stops sooner

say.hi: Ek hi line, 0 se 1. Ek baar 6 barabar tukde, ek baar 12. 12 bada number hai, par uska tukda chhota, aadha hi. Isliye 1/12 pehle rukta hai, 0 ke paas, aur 1/6 usse aage.
say.en: One line, 0 to 1. Cut it once into 6 equal pieces, once into 12. 12 is the bigger number, but its piece is smaller, only half as long. So 1/12 stops first, near 0, and 1/6 further on.

simpler.hi: Neeche ka number jitna bada, tukda utna chhota. Isliye 1/12, 1/6 se pehle aata hai, 0 ke paas.
simpler.en: The bigger the bottom number, the smaller the piece. So 1/12 comes before 1/6, near 0.

prompt.hi: Is line par 1/8 ka mark laga hai. 1/9 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/8 ke beech, ya 1/8 ke baad?
prompt.en: This line has a mark at 1/8. Where does 1/9 go: between 0 and 1/8, or after 1/8?

why.hi: 9 tukdon wala hissa 8 tukdon wale se thoda chhota hai, isliye 1/9, 0 aur 1/8 ke beech rukta hai
why.en: a ninth is a little smaller than an eighth, so 1/9 stops between 0 and 1/8

simpler.hi: 1/9 wala tukda 1/8 wale tukde se chhota hai. Chhota tukda 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai.
simpler.en: A 1/9 piece is smaller than a 1/8 piece. A smaller piece stops closer to 0.

remediation.move: road from home (0) to the chai stall (1 km) in 6 equal stretches; a toy walks from home and stops at the first mark → it stands on one real spot of the road → that spot has a number, 1/6 km → numbers live between 0 and 1

say.hi: Ghar se chai ki dukaan tak sadak hai, 0 se 1 km, 6 barabar hisson mein. Khilona chala aur pehle mark par ruk gaya. Woh sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, aur us jagah ka number hai 1/6 km.
say.en: There's a road from home to the chai stall, 0 to 1 km, in 6 equal stretches. A toy walks and stops at the first mark. It's standing on a real spot of the road, and that spot's number is 1/6 km.

simpler.hi: Khilona hawa mein nahi, sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai. Us jagah ka bhi number hai, 1/6 km.
simpler.en: The toy isn't floating; it stands on one real spot of the road. That spot has a number too, 1/6 km.

prompt.hi: Ab wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak 7 barabar hisson mein hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Kis number par khada hai?
prompt.en: Now the same 0 to 1 km road is in 7 equal stretches. The toy stops at the end of the first. What number is it on?

why.hi: sadak ke 7 barabar hisse hain, toh pehle hisse ka end 1/7 km par hai
why.en: the road is in 7 equal stretches, so the end of the first is at 1/7 km

simpler.hi: Poori sadak ek poora hai, 7 barabar hisson mein. Ek hissa poore ka kaunsa fraction hai, woh socho.
simpler.en: The whole road is one whole, in 7 equal stretches. Think which fraction of the whole one stretch is.

bridgeToNext.hi: Abhi tak hum 0 se sirf ek gap chale, jaise 1/4. Aage 2 ya 3 gap chalenge, aur upar ka number batayega kitne.
bridgeToNext.en: So far we've moved only one gap from 0, like 1/4. Next we'll move 2 or 3 gaps, and the top number will tell us how many.

hook.convey: same 0-to-1 stretch cut into equal stretches; the stop is not the first mark but several stretches on → its name needs two facts: how many equal stretches make the whole (bottom), how many are covered from 0 (top)

use.hi: Cricket pitch ko 4 barabar hisson mein baanto. Batsman 0 wale stump se bhaaga aur 3 hisse paar karke ruka. Uski jagah batane ke liye do cheezein chahiye: pitch ke kitne hisse hain, aur usne kitne paar kiye.
use.en: Split a cricket pitch into 4 equal parts. The batsman runs from the stump at 0 and stops after 3 parts. To name his spot we need two things: how many parts the pitch has, and how many he crossed.

use.hi: Game ka loading bar 0 se 1 tak hai, 5 barabar khaanon mein. Abhi 2 khaane bhare hain. Kitna bhara, yeh batane ke liye do number chahiye, neeche wala aur upar wala.
use.en: A game's loading bar runs from 0 to 1, in 5 equal boxes. Right now 2 boxes are full. To say how full it is, we need two numbers, a bottom one and a top one.

explain.convey: thirds: bottom 3 → 0 to 1 in 3 equal gaps; top 2 → 2 hops of 1/3 from 0; landing mark = 2/3 → one point, one number, not 2 and 3 separately

point.hi: Is baar line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 hop lagao, ek, do, aur hum 2/3 par aa gaye. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number.
point.en: This time the line is cut into 3 equal gaps, each gap 1/3. Take 2 hops from 0, one, two, and we're at 2/3. 2/3 is one place, one number.

prompt.hi: Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein kaato aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis fraction par pahunche?
prompt.en: Now cut the line into 4 equal gaps and take 3 hops from 0. Which fraction do you land on?

why.hi: har hop 1/4 ka, aur aise 3 hop mile toh 3/4
why.en: each hop is 1/4, and 3 of them make 3/4

simpler.hi: Neeche ka number batata hai line ke kitne gaps, upar ka batata hai kitne hop. Yahan 4 gaps hain aur 3 hop.
simpler.en: The bottom number says how many gaps, the top says how many hops. Here: 4 gaps, 3 hops.

explain.convey: still thirds: 3 hops of 1/3 → every gap used → land exactly on 1 → 3/3 = 1; top < bottom → stop before 1; top = bottom → reach 1

point.hi: Ab teesra hop dekho. Woh theek 1 par utra, aur wahan likha hai 3/3 = 1. Jab upar aur neeche barabar hon, hop theek 1 par khatam hote hain.
point.en: Watch the third hop. It lands right on 1, and there it says 3/3 = 1. When top equals bottom, the hops end exactly on 1.

prompt.hi: Socho har hop 1/5 ka hai. 0 se chalkar theek 1 par utarne ke liye kitne hop chahiye?
prompt.en: Say each hop is 1/5. How many hops from 0 to land exactly on 1?

why.hi: 1/5 ke 5 hop milkar 5/5 banate hain, aur 5/5 = 1
why.en: 5 hops of 1/5 make 5/5, and 5/5 = 1

simpler.hi: Teen hop se 1 aaya, kyunki 3/3 = 1. Ab 1/5 wale hop mein bhi upar ko neeche ke barabar lao.
simpler.en: Three hops reached 1, because 3/3 = 1. With 1/5 hops too, make the top match the bottom.

explain.convey: each third cut in 2 → 6 equal gaps; the middle = half of the 6 gaps = 3 gaps → 3/6 = 1/2; fewer than half the gaps (2/6) → before the middle; more than half (5/6) → after the middle

point.hi: Ab line ke 6 barabar gaps hain. Theek beech ka mark 3/6 hai, aur 3, 6 ka aadha hai, toh 3/6 = 1/2. 2/6 beech se pehle aata hai, 5/6 beech ke baad.
point.en: Now the line has 6 equal gaps. The mark right in the middle is 3/6, and 3 is half of 6, so 3/6 = 1/2. 2/6 comes before the middle, 5/6 after it.

prompt.hi: Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?
prompt.en: On this same line, where does 4/6 go: before the middle, or after it?

why.hi: beech 3/6 par hai, aur 4/6 usse ek gap aage, toh beech ke baad
why.en: the middle is at 3/6, and 4/6 is one gap further on, so after the middle

simpler.hi: Beech 3/6 par hai. Upar ka number 3 se chhota ho toh pehle, bada ho toh baad.
simpler.en: The middle is at 3/6. A top number below 3 comes before it, above 3 comes after.

problem.hi: Ek number line 0 se 1 tak hai. Is par 2/5 ka mark dhoondo.
problem.en: A number line runs from 0 to 1. Find the mark for 2/5.

givens.en: 2/5 has 5 on the bottom and 2 on top

do.hi: Neeche ka 5 dekho, aur 0 se 1 ko 5 barabar gaps mein kaato
do.en: Read the bottom 5 and cut 0 to 1 into 5 equal gaps

why.hi: neeche wala number hi poore ke gaps ginta hai
why.en: the bottom number is the count of gaps in the whole

simpler.hi: 2/5 ka neeche wala 5 hai. Toh line ke 5 barabar tukde karo, beech mein 4 marks aayenge.
simpler.en: The bottom of 2/5 is 5. So cut the line into 5 equal pieces; 4 marks land in between.

do.hi: Ab dekho ek gap kitne ka hai
do.en: Now see what one gap is worth

why.hi: 5 barabar gaps milke 1 poora banate hain
why.en: 5 equal gaps together make 1 whole

simpler.hi: Paanch gaps, aur sab milke ek poora. Toh ek gap poore ka 1/5 hai.
simpler.en: Five gaps make one whole together. So one gap is 1/5 of the whole.

prompt.hi: Ab upar wala number. 0 se utne gap aage chalo. 0 ke baad kaunse mark par ruke?
prompt.en: Now the top number. Move that many gaps on from 0. Which mark after 0 do you stop at?

simpler.hi: 2/5 ka upar wala 2 hai. 0 se ek-ek gap karke chalo, aur gino.
simpler.en: The top of 2/5 is 2. Step from 0 one gap at a time, and count.

why.hi: upar ka 2 kehta hai 0 se 1/5 ke 2 gap chalo
why.en: the top 2 says move 2 gaps of 1/5 from 0

prompt.hi: 0 aur 1 ke beech 5 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. 0 ke baad chautha mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: There are 5 evenly spaced marks between 0 and 1. What fraction is the 4th mark after 0?

why.hi: 5 marks se 6 barabar gaps bante hain, aur chautha mark 4 gaps par hai, yaani 4/6
why.en: 5 marks make 6 equal gaps, and the 4th mark is 4 gaps along, at 4/6

simpler.hi: Pehle gaps gino, woh marks se ek zyada hote hain. Phir 0 se chaar gap chalo.
simpler.en: First count the gaps, one more than the marks. Then walk four gaps from 0.

prompt.hi: Do tarah ke hop, 0 se 1 ki line par: 1/4 ke 3 hop, aur 1/8 ke 3 hop. 1 ke zyada paas kaun hai: 3/4 ya 3/8?
prompt.en: Two kinds of hops on a line from 0 to 1: 3 hops of 1/4, and 3 hops of 1/8. Which is closer to 1: 3/4 or 3/8?

why.hi: 1/4 ka hop 1/8 ke hop se do guna lamba hai, toh 3 lambe hop 3/4 tak, 1 ke zyada paas
why.en: a 1/4 hop is twice a 1/8 hop, so 3 long hops reach 3/4, nearer 1

simpler.hi: Hop ginti mein barabar hain, 3 aur 3. Farak hop ki lambai ka hai: 1/4 wala hop lamba hai.
simpler.en: The hop count is the same, 3 and 3. The difference is hop length: a 1/4 hop is longer.

prompt.hi: Line 0 se 3 tak hai. 3/4 kin do poore numbers ke beech aayega?
prompt.en: The line runs from 0 to 3. Between which two whole numbers does 3/4 go?

why.hi: 3/4 mein upar ka 3 neeche ke 4 se chhota, toh woh 1 se pehle, 0 aur 1 ke beech hai
why.en: in 3/4 the top 3 is less than the bottom 4, so it stops before 1, between 0 and 1

simpler.hi: 3/4 mein upar wala neeche wale se chhota hai. Matlab ek poora abhi bhara nahi.
simpler.en: In 3/4 the top is smaller than the bottom. So not even one whole is filled yet.

ladder.why: den 4: quarters already known from s1 and the c4 roti → carry a shaded 3 of 4 onto the line; top = gaps moved
den 5: same den as the worked example → locate 3/5 by gaps moved from 0, now one step further than 2/5
den 5 reversed: given the mark, name the fraction → 4/5 km; read the line instead of marking it
den 10: each fifth split in 2 → many small gaps, unit given as 1/10 km → 7 steps = 7/10
den 8 against den 4 → two different cuts, same stopping point (6/8 = 3/4); closes the loop back to quarters

remediation.move: hop arrows instead of marks: each hop = one equal gap = 1/7; hops start at 0, the start is not a hop; the fraction = hops made over hops that fill 0 to 1; 2 hops of 1/7 → 2/7

say.hi: Marks ki jagah hop dekho. Line ke 7 barabar gaps hain, toh har hop 1/7. 0 khud hop nahi hai, wahan se bas shuru karte hain. 0 se 2 hop, toh 2/7.
say.en: Look at hops instead of marks. The line has 7 equal gaps, so each hop is 1/7. 0 itself isn't a hop; we just start there. 2 hops from 0 is 2/7.

simpler.hi: 0 par sirf shuruaat hai. Har hop ek gap, yaani 1/7. Do hop, toh 2/7.
simpler.en: 0 is just the start. Each hop is one gap, 1/7. Two hops, 2/7.

prompt.hi: 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 4 chalk ke nishaan hain, barabar doori par. Teesra nishaan kitne metre par hai?
prompt.en: A 1 metre ribbon has 4 evenly spaced chalk marks in between. At how many metres is the third mark?

why.hi: 4 nishaan se 5 barabar tukde bante hain, aur teesra nishaan 3 tukdon par, yaani 3/5 metre
why.en: 4 marks make 5 equal pieces, and the third mark is 3 pieces along, at 3/5 metre

simpler.hi: Pehle tukde gino, nishaanon se ek zyada, woh neeche aayega. Upar aayenge teesre nishaan tak ke tukde.
simpler.en: First count the pieces, one more than the marks; that goes on the bottom. On top go the pieces up to the third mark.

remediation.move: same number of hops, different hop size, on one 0-to-1 line in sixths: a 1/3 hop is two 1/6 hops long; 2 hops of 1/6 stop at 2/6, 2 hops of 1/3 stop at 2/3 → bigger bottom number = shorter hops = stop nearer 0, further from 1

say.hi: Dono taraf 2 hop hain, par hop ki lambai alag. 1/3 ka hop 1/6 ke hop se do guna lamba hai. Toh 2 chhote hop 2/6 par rukte hain, aur 2 lambe hop 2/3 tak jaate hain.
say.en: Both sides are 2 hops, but the hops differ in length. A 1/3 hop is twice a 1/6 hop. So 2 short hops stop at 2/6, and 2 long hops reach 2/3.

simpler.hi: Hop do-do hi hain. 1/3 wala hop bada, toh 2/3 aage, aur 1/6 wala chhota, toh 2/6 peeche.
simpler.en: Two hops each. The 1/3 hop is bigger, so 2/3 is further on, and the 1/6 hop is smaller, so 2/6 stays back.

prompt.hi: 1/4 ke 2 hop, 0 se 1 ki line par, 2/4 tak jaate hain. 1/8 ke 2 hop 2/4 se pehle rukenge, ya baad mein?
prompt.en: On a line from 0 to 1, 2 hops of 1/4 reach 2/4. Do 2 hops of 1/8 stop before 2/4, or after?

why.hi: 1/8 ka hop 1/4 ke hop ka aadha hai, toh 2 hop sirf 2/8 tak, 2/4 se pehle
why.en: a 1/8 hop is half a 1/4 hop, so 2 of them reach only 2/8, before 2/4

simpler.hi: 1/8 wala hop 1/4 wale se chhota hai. Hop utne hi, par chhote, toh safar bhi chhota.
simpler.en: A 1/8 hop is shorter than a 1/4 hop. Same number of hops, but shorter, so a shorter trip.

remediation.move: km stones on a highway from 0 to 1 km, a stone every 1/5 km; a toy walks 4 stretches and stops → it stands on one single stone → that stone's number is 4/5 km, one point between 0 and 1, not two numbers

say.hi: Yeh 0 se 1 km ka highway hai, har 1/5 km par ek patthar. Khilona 4 hop chala aur chauthe patthar par ruka. Woh ek hi patthar par khada hai, toh uska number bhi ek: 4/5 km.
say.en: This is a highway from 0 to 1 km, with a stone every 1/5 km. The toy hops 4 times and stops on the fourth stone. It's on one stone, so it has one number: 4/5 km.

simpler.hi: Khilona ek hi patthar par hai. Ek jagah, ek number, 4/5 km.
simpler.en: The toy is on one stone. One spot, one number: 4/5 km.

prompt.hi: Highway 0 se 1 km, har 1/5 km par patthar. Khilona 0 ke baad doosre patthar par ruka. Kis number par hai?
prompt.en: A highway from 0 to 1 km, a stone every 1/5 km. The toy stops at the second stone after 0. What number is it on?

why.hi: har patthar 1/5 km aage hai, toh doosra patthar 2/5 km par
why.en: each stone is 1/5 km further on, so the second stone is at 2/5 km

simpler.hi: Ek patthar se agla, 1/5 km. 0 se doosre patthar tak aise kitne tukde hain, gino.
simpler.en: Stone to stone is 1/5 km. Count how many of those there are from 0 to the second stone.

bridgeToNext.hi: Upar ka number neeche se chhota, jaise 3/4, toh hum 1 se pehle ruke. Dono barabar, jaise 4/4, toh theek 1 par. Ab dekhte hain, upar wala bada ho toh hop 1 ke aage kaise jaate hain.
bridgeToNext.en: Top smaller than bottom, like 3/4, and we stopped before 1. Both equal, like 4/4, and we landed right on 1. Next: when the top is bigger, how the hops go past 1.

hook.convey: one whole is finished and the mover keeps going → the stopping point is past 1 → it needs a fraction name bigger than 1 → the line must go on beyond 1

use.hi: Cricket mein ek run matlab pitch ki poori lambai, yaani 1. Batsman ek run pura karke doosre ke liye bhaaga, aur aadhi pitch par ruk gaya. Woh 1 se aage hai, toh uska fraction bhi 1 se bada hoga.
use.en: In cricket one run is the full length of the pitch, that is 1. The batsman finishes one run, sets off on a second, and stops halfway. He's past 1, so his fraction is bigger than 1.

use.hi: Train station 0 se chali, station 1 paar kiya, aur station 2 se pehle raaste mein ruk gayi. Uski jagah 1 ke aage hai, toh number line ko bhi 1 ke aage le jaana padega.
use.en: A train leaves station 0, passes station 1, and stops before station 2. Its spot is past 1, so the number line has to go past 1 too.

explain.convey: the line does not stop at 1 → it carries on to 2; the second whole is cut the same way → 4 equal gaps per whole, all the same size; 4 gaps from 0 = 4/4 = 1; the gap count from 0 keeps growing past 4

point.hi: Line ab 1 par nahi rukti, 2 tak jaati hai. Har poore ke 4 barabar gaps, aur 1 wale mark par likha hai 4/4 = 1. 1 ke aage bhi gaps usi size mein chalte rehte hain.
point.en: Now the line doesn't stop at 1; it goes on to 2. Each whole has 4 equal gaps, and the mark at 1 says 4/4 = 1. Beyond 1 the gaps keep going, same size.

prompt.hi: Ab ek line socho jahan har hop 1/3 ka hai. 0 se 4 hop lo. 1 se pehle rukoge, ya 1 ke baad?
prompt.en: Now picture a line where each hop is 1/3. Take 4 hops from 0. Do you stop before 1, or after?

why.hi: 3 hop se 3/3 = 1 aa gaya, toh chautha hop 1 ke baad, 4/3 par
why.en: 3 hops already make 3/3 = 1, so the 4th hop lands after 1, at 4/3

simpler.hi: Yaad karo, 4/4 = 1 tha. 1/3 wale hop mein bhi kuch hop 1 tak le jaate hain, aur baaki 1 ke aage.
simpler.en: Remember, 4/4 = 1. With 1/3 hops too, some hops take you to 1, and the rest go past it.

explain.convey: 6 hops of 1/4 from 0: the first 4 hops fill one whole → reach 1; 2 more hops → past 1 → 6/4 = 1 and 2/4; top > bottom → beyond 1

point.hi: Dekho, 0 se 6 hop, har hop 1/4. Pehle 4 hop 1 tak, phir 2 hop aur, aur hum 6/4 par, 1 aur 2 ke beech. 6/4 mein upar ka number bada hai neeche ke 4 se, isliye hum 1 ke aage nikal gaye.
point.en: Look, 6 hops from 0, each 1/4. The first 4 hops reach 1, then 2 more, and we're at 6/4, between 1 and 2. In 6/4 the top number is bigger than the bottom 4, so we went past 1.

prompt.hi: Ab ek alag line, jis par har hop 1/2 ka hai. 0 se 6 hop lo. Kis poore number par pahunchoge?
prompt.en: Now a different line, where each hop is 1/2. Take 6 hops from 0. Which whole number do you reach?

why.hi: 1/2 ke 2 hop se 1 banta hai, toh 6 hop mein 3 poore
why.en: 2 half-hops make 1, so 6 hops make 3 wholes

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho kitne hop se 1 banta hai. Phir 6 hop ko utne-utne ke group mein baanto.
simpler.en: First see how many hops make 1. Then split the 6 hops into groups of that size.

explain.convey: thirds on a line to 3: every 3 gaps = one whole → 3/3 = 1; group the gaps in threes to find which wholes a fraction has passed; top above 3 → past 1

point.hi: Yeh line 0 se 3 tak hai, har poore ke 3 barabar gaps. Pehle teen gaps 1 par khatam hote hain, wahan 3/3 = 1. Teen-teen gaps ka ek group, aur har group ek poora.
point.en: This line runs from 0 to 3, each whole in 3 equal gaps. The first three gaps end at 1, where it says 3/3 = 1. Take the gaps in groups of three gaps; each group is one whole.

prompt.hi: Teen-teen ke group banao. 7/3 kin do poore numbers ke beech aayega?
prompt.en: Make groups of three. Between which two whole numbers does 7/3 lie?

why.hi: 6/3 = 2, aur 7/3 usse ek gap aage, 9/3 = 3 se pehle
why.en: 6/3 = 2, and 7/3 is one gap past it, before 9/3 = 3

simpler.hi: Har 3 gaps par ek poora number aata hai. Ab 7/3 ke gaps ko teen-teen karke gino.
simpler.en: Every 3 gaps reach a whole number. Now count the gaps of 7/3 in threes.

problem.hi: Ek number line 0 se 2 tak hai. Is par 7/4 ka mark dhoondo.
problem.en: A number line runs from 0 to 2. Find the mark for 7/4.

givens.en: 7/4 has 4 on the bottom and 7 on top

do.hi: Line par 0, 1 aur 2 likho, aur har poore ke 4 barabar gaps karo
do.en: Write 0, 1 and 2 on the line, and cut each whole into 4 equal gaps

steps.result: 0 se 2 tak 8 barabar hisse, har hissa 1/4

why.hi: neeche 4 hai, aur 7/4, 1 ke aage bhi ja sakta hai, isliye line 2 tak chahiye
why.en: the bottom is 4, and 7/4 may go past 1, so the line has to reach 2

simpler.hi: 0, 1, 2 likho. Har poore ke 4 barabar tukde, toh kul 8 gaps, har gap 1/4.
simpler.en: Write 0, 1, 2. Four equal pieces in each whole, so 8 gaps in all, each one 1/4.

do.hi: Upar ka 7 matlab 7 gap chalna hai, toh pehle 4 gap chalo
do.en: The top 7 means 7 gaps to move, so first move 4

why.hi: ek poore mein 4 quarter hote hain, aur 7, 4 se bada hai
why.en: one whole holds 4 quarters, and 7 is bigger than 4

simpler.hi: 7 gap chalne hain. Pehle 4 chalo, tum 1 par aa gaye, kyunki 4/4 = 1.
simpler.en: 7 gaps to move. Move 4 first and you're at 1, because 4/4 = 1.

prompt.hi: Kul 7 gap chalne the, aur 4 gap mein hum 1 tak aa gaye. 1 ke baad aur kitne gap bache?
prompt.en: We had 7 gaps to move, and 4 got us to 1. How many more are left after 1?

simpler.hi: Kul 7 the, 4 ho gaye. Baaki nikalne ke liye 7 mein se 4 ghatao.
simpler.en: 7 in all, 4 done. Take 4 away from 7 to get the rest.

answer.hi: 7/4, 1 ke baad teesra mark hai, yaani 1 aur 3/4, 2 se bas ek gap pehle
answer.en: 7/4 is the 3rd mark after 1, that is 1 and 3/4, just one gap before 2

why.hi: 7 = 4 + 3: pehle 4 quarter se 1 poora hua, baaki 3 quarter 1 ke aage gaye
why.en: 7 = 4 + 3: the first 4 quarters make 1 whole, the other 3 go past 1

prompt.hi: Ek line lo, 0 se 2 tak, har poora 3 barabar gaps mein. 5/3 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?
prompt.en: Take a line from 0 to 2, each whole in 3 equal gaps. Between which two whole numbers is 5/3?

why.hi: 3/3 = 1 aur 6/3 = 2, aur 5/3 dono ke beech hai
why.en: 3/3 = 1 and 6/3 = 2, and 5/3 sits between them

simpler.hi: 3 gaps milke ek poora. 5/3 ka upar wala 3 se bada hai, toh 1 ke aage dhoondo.
simpler.en: 3 gaps make one whole. The top of 5/3 is bigger than 3, so look past 1.

prompt.hi: Line 0 se 2 tak. 1/4 ke 5 hop lo, ya 1/8 ke 5 hop. 0 se zyada door kaun gaya: 5/4 ya 5/8?
prompt.en: A line from 0 to 2. Take 5 hops of 1/4, or 5 hops of 1/8. Which goes further from 0: 5/4 or 5/8?

why.hi: 1/4 ka hop 1/8 ke hop se do guna hai, toh 5 lambe hop 5/4 tak, 5/8 se kaafi aage
why.en: a 1/4 hop is twice a 1/8 hop, so 5 long hops reach 5/4, well past 5/8

simpler.hi: Hop dono taraf 5 hain. Lamba hop kaunsa hai, 1/4 wala ya 1/8 wala, bas yeh socho.
simpler.en: 5 hops on each side. Just think which hop is longer, the 1/4 one or the 1/8 one.

prompt.hi: Number line 0 se 3 tak hai. 8/3 kahaan aayega, kin do poore numbers ke beech?
prompt.en: The number line goes from 0 to 3. Where does 8/3 go: between which two whole numbers?

checks.wrongIfMis: it cannot go on the number line

why.hi: 8/3 se ek gap aage 9/3 = 3 hai, aur do gap peeche 6/3 = 2
why.en: one gap past 8/3 is 9/3 = 3, and two gaps back is 6/3 = 2

simpler.hi: Teen gap, ek poora. 8/3 ke gaps teen-teen karke gino, aur dekho kitne poore paar hue.
simpler.en: Three gaps, one whole. Count the gaps of 8/3 in threes, and see how many wholes you pass.

ladder.why: den 4 on 0 to 2, same den and line as e1, e2 and the worked example → 5/4 = one quarter past 1; smallest step beyond 1
den 3, no line given → decide before/after 1 from top vs bottom alone (4 > 3); moves the rule off the picture
den 2 inside a story: 1 km + half km → count in halves → 3/2; build the improper fraction from a real distance
den 3 again but out to 3 → 8 marks grouped in threes → past two wholes (between 2 and 3); hardest grouping

remediation.move: quarter-pieces laid end to end on a 0-to-2 line, no squeezing: 4 pieces fill 0 to 1 exactly → 1 is full → the 5th piece must go past 1; a fraction is a length, and lengths can exceed one whole

say.hi: Hop 1/4 ke hain, line 0 se 2 tak. Pehle 4 hop 0 se 1 ko pura bhar dete hain, wahan likha hai 4/4 = 1. Paanchve hop ki jagah andar bachi hi nahi, toh woh 1 ke aage utarta hai.
say.en: The hops are 1/4 each, on a line from 0 to 2. The first 4 hops fill 0 to 1 completely, where it says 4/4 = 1. There's no room left inside for the fifth hop, so it lands past 1.

simpler.hi: 4/4 = 1, matlab 0 se 1 bhar gaya. Paanchva hop andar nahi aata, 1 ke aage jaata hai.
simpler.en: 4/4 = 1, so 0 to 1 is full. The fifth hop doesn't fit inside; it goes past 1.

prompt.hi: Ek line 0 se 2 lap tak hai, har lap ke 6 barabar hisse. Runner 7 hisse daudta hai. Fraction mein kitne lap hue?
prompt.en: A line goes from 0 to 2 laps, each lap in 6 equal parts. A runner runs 7 parts. How many laps is that, as a fraction?

why.hi: har hissa 1/6 lap hai, aur runner ne 7 hisse daude, toh 7/6 lap
why.en: each part is 1/6 of a lap and the runner ran 7 parts, so 7/6 laps

simpler.hi: Har lap ke 6 hisse, toh neeche 6. Upar woh ginti, jitne hisse runner daudta hai.
simpler.en: 6 parts per lap, so 6 on the bottom. On top, the number of parts the runner runs.

remediation.move: same top, different bottom, on one 0-to-2 line in eighths: 7/8 → top 7 < bottom 8 → stops before 1; 7/4 → top 7 > bottom 4 → past 1; same top, bigger bottom → smaller pieces → nearer 0

say.hi: Teen mark dekho, 0 se 2 ki line par: 7/8, 1 aur 7/4. 7/8 mein upar ka 7 neeche ke 8 se chhota, toh woh 1 se pehle. 7/4 mein upar ka 7 neeche ke 4 se bada, toh 1 ke aage.
say.en: Look at three marks on a line from 0 to 2: 7/8, 1 and 7/4. In 7/8 the top 7 is smaller than the bottom 8, so it's before 1. In 7/4 the top 7 is bigger than the bottom 4, so it's past 1.

simpler.hi: Upar wala neeche se chhota, toh 1 se pehle; bada, toh 1 ke aage. Isliye 7/8 pehle aur 7/4 aage.
simpler.en: Top smaller than bottom means before 1; bigger means past 1. So 7/8 comes before, and 7/4 goes past.

prompt.hi: Is 0 se 2 ki line par 1 ka mark laga hai. 0 se zyada door kaun hai: 3/2 ya 3/4?
prompt.en: This line from 0 to 2 has a mark at 1. Which is further from 0: 3/2 or 3/4?

why.hi: 3/2 mein upar ka 3 neeche ke 2 se bada, toh woh 1 ke aage; 3/4, 1 se pehle ruk jaata hai
why.en: in 3/2 the top 3 is bigger than the bottom 2, so it is past 1, while 3/4 stops before 1

simpler.hi: Jis fraction ka upar wala neeche wale se bada ho, woh 1 ke paar jaata hai. Dono ko aise jaancho.
simpler.en: A fraction whose top is bigger than its bottom goes past 1. Check both that way.

remediation.move: train between stations: station 0, station 1, station 2; each station-to-station stretch in 5 equal parts; the train runs 7 parts and halts → it is at one real spot on the track → that spot is 7/5, a single number past station 1

say.hi: Yeh stations ki line hai, 0 se 2. Har do station ke beech 5 barabar hisse, toh station 1 par 1 = 5/5. Train 0 se 7 hisse chali aur 7/5 par ruki: ek pakki jagah, ek hi number.
say.en: This is a line of stations, 0 to 2. Between stations there are 5 equal parts, so at station 1, 1 = 5/5. The train goes 7 parts from 0 and stops at 7/5: one real spot, one number.

simpler.hi: 5 hisse milke ek poora, isliye 1 = 5/5. Train 7 hisse chali, aur ek hi jagah ruki, 7/5 par.
simpler.en: 5 parts make one whole, so 1 = 5/5. The train went 7 parts and stopped at one spot, 7/5.

prompt.hi: Isi 0 se 2 ki line par ek doosri train station 1 se chali aur 3 hisse aage ruki. Woh kis fraction par khadi hai?
prompt.en: On this line from 0 to 2, another train starts at station 1 and stops 3 parts on. What fraction is it standing on?

why.hi: station 1 = 5/5 hai, aur 3 hisse aage 5 + 3 = 8, yaani 8/5
why.en: station 1 is 5/5, and 3 parts on makes 5 + 3 = 8 parts, that is 8/5

simpler.hi: 1 tak pahunchne mein jitne hisse lage, usme 3 aur jodo. Woh kul ginti upar aati hai.
simpler.en: Take the parts it takes to reach 1 and add 3 more. That total goes on top.
